title: AWS command transport uses explicitly managed infrastructure
description:
As a platform operator, I want the AWS command transport and worker service provisioned explicitly, so that runtime startup does not create infrastructure or depend on static cloud credentials.

Feature: Managed AWS command transport
  Scenario: The AWS worker service starts
    Given its queue, dead-letter queue, roles, logs, and service were deployed through infrastructure as code
    When a worker starts with its workload identity
    Then it consumes only its configured queue
    And it does not create queues or result tables
    And it does not require static cloud access keys
